title: 21# The Family Of Imran Part 3
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِذْ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ ۖ

مَنْ أَنصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ اللَّهِ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ۝

اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ Fear Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ۝

قَالُواْ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ۝

وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ۝

قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِررِنَا تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا

لصائم فرحتان وَآيَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ۝

وَارْزُقْنَا وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

عِلمٍ لا يَنفَع عِلمٍ لا يَنفَع ترف علم عِلمٍ لا يَنفَع وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ۝

خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ۝

إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِيسَىٰ إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ مُتَوَفِّيكَ إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ وفيه الاجر وفيه الاجر وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا

إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ فإنه لا سبيل إلى السعادة والفلاح في الدنيا، ولا في الآخرة إلا على أيدي الرسل، ولا سبيلَ إلى معرفة الطيب والخبيث على التفصيل إلا مِن جهتهم، ولا يُنال رضا الله البتة إلا على أيديهم،

فالطَّيِّب من الأعمال والأقوال والأخلاق، ليس إلا هديهم وما جاؤوا به، فهم الميزانُ الراجح الذي على أقوالهم وأخلاقهم تُوزن الأخلاق والأعمال، وبمتابعتهم يتميز أهل الضلال

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Surat un-Nisa'(سورةالنّساء); إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يُفَرِّقُوا بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ

وَيَقُولُونَ نُؤْمِنُ بِبَعْضٍ وَنَكْفُرُ بِبَعْضٍ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا۝ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ حَقًّا ۚ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Surat Ash-Shu'ra'(سورت الشُّعراء); كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ۝

آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وكذلك الأنبياء تنام ‏‏‏‏أعينهم ولا تنام قلوبهم ما من نبي يمرض إلا خير بين الدنيا والآخرة

يقبر حيث يموت لن يُقبَرَ نبيٌّ إلَّا حيثُ يموتُ إنَّ اللهَ حرَّم على الأرضِ أن تأكلَ أجسادَ الأنبياءِ الأنبياء أحياء في قبورهم يصلون لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ

ونسئلك ان تجعلنا ممن يحب انبياءك
english:
One story that was mentioned to us in Qur'an, gives us an impression about the Hawariyyeen(حواريّين).

And the Hawariyyeen(حواريّين) are the Sahabah(صحابه) of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى).

The followers or the companions of Sayidina Muhammadﷺ were called Sahabah(صحابه).

The Companions of Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام were called Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين).

In English; The disciples.

These Ayaat(آيات) are in Surat ul Maidah(سورةالمائدة).

And Al-Maidah(المائدة) is named after these Ayaat(آيات); because Al-Maidah(المائدة) means; a table.

Remember! When Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين); The disciples said, Oh Eesa(عيسى)! And Eesa(عيسى) is Jesus.

And by the way, the name Eesa(عيسى) is closer to the right pronunciation of his real name, than Jesus is.

Because, in the Aramaic language of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) and the people of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى), the letter ''J'' did not exist.

So the name Jesus isn't truly his name.

His name is Eesa(عيسى) or at least it's a closer pronunciation of the name of Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام.

But in English; now it's called Jesus.

They said; Can your Lord send down to us a table spread with food from heaven?

So the companions, Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين), and we'll use the name Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين) from now on, the disciples.

Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين); they came to Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام, and they said; Can your Lord send us a table?

Now, if this question means; Is Allah able to do so?

Then this is Kuffr(كفر).

What do you mean, Allah is not able to bring down a table from the sky?

You're doubting the ability of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Can Allah bring down the table? Of course, Allah can.

Is that the meaning they intended?

According to some scholars; yes, but the majority say; that's not what they intended.

Especially, when we know in Qur'an Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says about Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين).

Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام said; Who are my supporters in the sake of Allah?

The Hawariyyeen(حواريّين) said; we are going to be the ones who will give victory to the religion of Allah.

We believed in Allah and be a witness that we are Muslims.

So this Ayah(آية) gives us an indication that, the that the followers of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) were firm believers, who believed in him,

and believed in Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and believed in Islam.

So we cannot expect from them to come to Eesa(عيسى) and ask him; Can Allah bring down a table, as if they're questioning the ability of Allah to do so.

So what does this Ayah(آية) means?

The scholars say that, what they meant by this question is; is it possible for you to ask Allah to bring down a table for us?

Can Allah bring down a table?

So they're asking him; can Allah do this for us?

Is it something that you can ask Allah to do for us?

You get the meaning.

There are two different things.

But again; it's not something that the Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ did.

The followers of Muhammadﷺ never requested Allahسُبحانه وتعالى to send down a miracle.

Never!

Never did any one of the companions; The Sahabahرضى الله عنهم come to Rasool Allah ﷺ and say; Perform for us a miracle; Never!

They never did it.

So the Hawariyyeen(حواريّين); they did come to Eesa(عيسى), and they asked for a miracle.

Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام said; Why are you asking me to do so?

Fear Allah, if you are indeed believer.

They gave their justifications.

They said; They said; We wish to eat, thereof.

They might have been very hungry, and they wanted Rizq(رزق) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

And it's okay to ask for Rizq(رزق) from Allah.

And to satisfy our hearts.

When we see miracle, it will satisfy our hearts.

It will make our Eeman(ايمان); firmer and stronger.

So that's number two.

And to know that you have indeed told us the truth.

And again; you can see here a little bit of a difference again between the Sahabah(صحابه) of Muhammadﷺ and Hawariyyeen(حواريّين).

The are saying; we want to see this, to make sure that you have told us the truth.

And that, we ourselves be its witnesses.

Now even though, they made this the last justification.

It should have been the first; because it has the strongest foundation.

They said; we want to be witnesses.

In other words, they're asking Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) to perform this miracles in front of their eyes, so that, they can be witnesses in front of mankind; to say that we have seen this miracle with our eyes.

So when they go in Da'wah(دعوة), and when they go to convey the message of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they can tell the people that, we have seen Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم) performed this miracle in front of our eyes;

We will witness that, we will be witnesses in front of mankind.

They convinced Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام with the validity of their request.

Jesus, son of Mary said; Eesa(عيسى); Jesus; son of Mary said; Oh Allah, our Lord! Send us from the heaven a table spread with food.

Now, when Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام made a Dua(دُعَا), and he was telling Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, why he wants the table.

He did not use the same four justifications that Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين) used.

But he said; Maybe for us a festival for the first and the last of us.

Eesa(عيسى) said; send down this table.

So that number one; it would be Eid(عيد) for us.

What does Eid(عيد) mean?

Eid(عيد) is a festival; but if we look at the linguistic meaning of the word Eid(عيد); Min Ya'ud(من يعود).

Eid(عيد) in Arabic; it would mean; something that returns.

It returns again and again.

It would mean; something that is good.

So why do we say Eid(عيد) a celebration?

Because it's something that comes on a yearly basis like, Eid-ul-Fitr(عيدالفطر) and Eid-ul-Adha(عيدالاضحى), or it comes on a weekly basis like, Al-Jumu'ah(جُمعه).

And it's a moment of celebration, a good moment, a pleasurable moment.

So we wanted to come again and again.

Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام wanted this to be Eid(عيد) for them.

So that, they would remember the blessing of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Just as Eid-ul-Fitr(عيدالفطر) for example, is a celebration for us because we have completed the fasting of the month of Ramadan(رمضان), and now we are breaking our fast.

And that's why, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; For the person who's fasting has two moments of happiness; once when they break their fasting, and once on the day of judgment when they see the reward of their fasting.

Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) said; we want this to be Eid(عيد) for us.

And then he said; It will be assigned from You; a miracle.

Provide for us sustenance; You Are the best of Sustainers.

Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين), they said; Number one; What?

We want to eat.

Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) made it the last reason.

Give us Rizq(رزق).

And Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) did not limited to food.

He did not say; Oh Allah! Give us this table to be food for us.

Because food is only a very small part of Rizq(رزق).

And Eesa(عيسى) made a comprehensive, and we learned from the Adiya(ادعیا) of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء); he made this comprehensive and said; Oh Allah! Give us Rizq(رزق).

Not only limited to food on a table; give us Rizq(رزق).

And Rizq(رزق) would include food, wealth, anything that you own, anything that you have.

Knowledge is also a form of Rizq(رزق); all of this is a Rizq(رزق) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Oh Allah! Give us and You Are the best of Providers.

Allah said; I am going to send it down unto you; I will send it down.

Allah says; I'm going to send it down unto you; but if any of you after that disbelieves; then I will punish him with a torment such as, I have not inflicted on anyone among all the world.

When you ask for an Ayah(آية); when you ask for a miracle, and the miracle is performed, and then you disbelieve, it is worse than disbelieving without seeing a miracle.

Why?

Because you have asked Allah to provide you with a proof, and He provided you with the proof; nevertheless, you refused.

And that's why, the more a person knows; the more a person is knowledgeable; the more responsible they become.

I mean, the responsibility on the scholar is greater than the responsibility on the layman, who has very limited information.

Why?

Because the scholar now, has many of the Ayaat(آيات) of Allah with him; which makes it, the greater obligation.

And that's why, we know that the first three whom will be burnt in hellfire are who?

The scholar, and the Shaheed(شَهِيد), and who?

And the man who spent a lot of money.

Why?

Because these are people who had signs of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, had Ni'mah(نِعْمَة) from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, and then they didn't use it right.

The scholar used it to show off.

And the Shaheed(شَهِيد) was fighting not for the sake of Allah, but was fighting for what?

For fame.

And then the other person was being generous; just to show the person; the people that he is generous.

When you have seen the sign from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; the obligation becomes greater.

This is the story of Al-Maidah(المائدة), and most of the scholars agreed that the Maidah(مائدة) was sent down.

Now, in some of the books of Tafseer(تفسير); the old books of Tafseer(تفسير); they mentioned, for example; the type of food that came down.

They said; it was a fish that came down from the sky.

And the fish was surrounded by five loaves of bread.

One bread had olives, and one bread had cheese, and Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله)! This is; This is knowledge that does not benefit.

And as the tradition, that we have been following throughout the series of the lives of the Prophet, that we stay away from; We stay away from the things that are not verified.

If something is not confirmed by the Ayah(آية) of Qur'an or the Hadith(حديث); we stay away from it.

What's the use of knowing, whether it was fish or meat or olives or bread?

What is the benefit?

Qur'an did not mentioned it, because there is no use to knowing such information.

And that is; That is luxury of knowledge.

And that is; Knowledge that does not benefit.

It is knowledge that would not make you ignorant if you don't know it; and knowledge that will not make you knowledgeable if you do know it.

And there's a lot of stories that were attributed to Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى) that would fall under this category, and we're going to stay away from all of them.

If it does not confirmed strongly by the Ayah(آية) of Qur'an or the Hadith(حديث); then it's better to refrain from it.

Why?

Because Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Would not hide away from us knowledge, if it's beneficial for us, if it's going to provide us with; Huda(هدى); guidance.

The Yahood(يهود) in the time of Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام; they rejected the message of Eesa(عيسى), and a very small group believed in him.

And these were Al-Hawariyyeen(الحواريّين).

The rest of the community; whether it was the community itself, which were the jews, or the authorities, which were the Romans; they rejected the message of Eesaعليه السلام.

The Jews plotted against Eesa(عيسى), and they conspired against him, with the government.

They made a plot with the government, to assassinate and get rid of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى).

And the Roman authorities joined with the Yahood(يهود) in that conspiracy.

The Yahood(يهود) are the ones who instigated it and then the Jews actually use the Romans to perform that plot against Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى).

And the decree was issued that, Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام should be executed in public, by carrying him over the cross, and putting a crown over his head.

Not the crown of gold or silver; but thorns.

And to nail him to the cross, and let him bleed till death.

And that was a very gruesome way of execution that they used to do.

They would make a cross out of wood.

And then, they would nail the hands and the feet to the cross.

They would hit nails in the hands, and hang you on the cross and you would bleed from this injury from your feet and your hands until you die.

And you could stay for hours and hours in the sun on that cross; dying a very slow death.

So it was a very gruesome way of execution.

So the law has been decreed that, Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام should be executed.

We don't know the exact details of what happened.

But there is a narration by Ibn Abbas(إبن عباس) and again; I'm not sure of the authenticity of this narration.

So we don't approve it or disapprove it.

But it says that Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام ran into a room where all of his Hawariyyeen(حواريّين) were sitting.

And then he told them; who will volunteer to sacrifice their life for me.

One of the young, Hawariyyeen(حواريّين) raised up his hand and said; I will!

Eesaعليه السلام asked another time; he's the only one who responded, he asked for a third time; that young man was the only one who responded.

And this sacrifice is similar to what Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) did, when Rasool Allah ﷺ was in Al-Hijrah(هجرة).

And incidentally enough, Subhan Allah(سُبْحان الله)! Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) was young at that time.

This young man came out, and Allahسُبحانه وتعالى put on him the resemblance of Sayidina Eesa عليه السلام.

And he was the one who was crucified.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى opened for Eesa(عيسى) a window in the roof, and he was picked up by the angels safely and elevated to the heavens.

This is one story.

The other story is that, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى put the resemblance on one of the Jews who was an enemy of Sayidina Eesa(سيدنا عيسى).

So Allah put the resemblance on him, and he was the one who was hanged on the cross.

Regardless of who was hanged on the cross; it is not Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم).

That is, what we are sure about; It was not Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم).

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says in Surat Al-Imran(آلعمران); And they disbelievers plotted to kill Eesa(عيسى), and Allah plotted too; and Allah Is the best of those, who plot.

Makar(مَكَر) means; when you plan in secret; when you're whispering; hiding in a room making a plan, that is called Makar(مَكَر).

They think that they are doing Makar(مَكَر).

They think that they're concealing their plan, and nobody knows their plan.

But there is one who knows their plan, and that is Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Allah knows their plan so Allah is; Allah Is the best of plotters.

Because Allah; when He makes His plan; His plan can be secret and concealed, if Allah doesn't want anybody to know it.

So they made their plan; but Allah made His plan.

And the plan of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى is what we'll go through.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى said; Oh Eesa(عيسى)! I Will take you.

Many who read this Ayah(آية) think that Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم) died.

Why?

Because the word Wafa(وَفَى) in Arabic means, death.

Tuwuffi(تُوَفِّىْ) means; he died.

Wafa(وَفَى) is death.

So, when Allah says; When people read this, they think that Allah Is telling Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم) that; I Will make you die.

But that is caused because of not knowing the meanings of words, and not knowing the original meaning of a word.

It is true that, in the Arabic language of today and the Arabic language of yesterday; the word Mutawaffik(مُتَوَفِّيكَ) can mean death.

But it also has other meanings.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى refer to sleep as Wafa(وَفَى).

So what does it mean?

Does it mean death, or does it mean sleep?

The word Wafa(وَفَى) also has another third meaning, and that is; to take something completely.

When you say; Means pay him in full.

Over here the word Wafa(وَفَى) means; Allah's telling Eesa Ibn Maryam(عيسى ابن مريم); I Am going to take you in full, without any single injury.

You are going to be taken entirely.

You're not going to be harmed at all.

So Allahسُبحانه وتعالى Is not going to take your soul alone.

Nor Is Allahسُبحانه وتعالى going to take your body alone.

Allah Is going to take your soul and your body intact without any injury or harm.
